integrity: Proof is symbolic for every positive a,b. Finite full-matrix verifications are reproducibility checks, not proof replacements. Source date is the initial public arXiv date for arXiv:2107.05580.
scientific_limitations: Classification restricted to unweighted simple graphs K_a join edgeless_b, localized vertex starts, same real time and all vertex probabilities; no arbitrary graph, initial superposition, or mixing-time conclusion. Literature overlap risk persists outside checked sources.
title: Complete classification of adjacency–Laplacian quantum-walk equivalence on complete split graphs
